opening.argument: The video is structured as travel entertainment about Dublin and Ireland, moving through local attractions, food, pubs, and activities. It opens with “our journey about the Irish capital Dublina” and includes a tourist-volunteer meeting where “each tourist can meet one of the 3,000 volunteers here through a special app.” The free-beer reference appears within that tourist meeting, while the euro figure prices “a gastronomic adventure” consisting of an algae lunch, not an earning opportunity. The later $100-bottle directions are presented as a possible staged or program-specific treasure-hunt segment: viewers are addressed as “treasure hunters,” but no payout, viewer obligation, or deceptive transaction is established.

citations.quote: Now our journey about the Irish capital Dublina begins.
It means that each tourist can meet one of the 3,000 volunteers here through a special app.
If you have the money, you can buy a gastronomic adventure for 350 Euros – a lunch from the algae!
Dear treasure hunters! Follow the $100 bottle and head to Claire Island.
